rule: A gate may be skipped only when equivalent current evidence already exists.

gates.name: Requirements ready
exit_evidence: material business rules mapped to executable examples/counterexamples or equivalent current evidence

gates.name: Implementation ready
exit_evidence: applicable approved/enforced Project Constitution rules identified; unresolved convention conflicts remain explicit

gates.name: Verification passed
exit_evidence: manual/runtime evidence where automation is insufficient
verification matrix resolves the dimensions required by the current risk/execution profile
reality check evidence when user/business/operational behavior materially changed
pragmatic/over-engineering review when implementation materially increased abstraction or architecture

gates.name: Security/performance passed
exit_evidence: unresolved risks explicitly accepted or blocked
AI governance/data-classification/capability evidence when AI tools or agents cross non-public data or consequential tool boundaries

gates.name: Release ready
exit_evidence: production-readiness evidence for EVIDENCE_HEAVY or other production-affecting work

gates.name: Production healthy
exit_evidence: expected vs observed production evidence for critical behaviors/outcomes where production exposure exists

gates.name: Outcome measured
exit_evidence: learning propagated to affected model/test/eval/knowledge artifacts when assumptions changed
Definition of Value status supported by outcome evidence or explicitly UNVERIFIED
